title: Ankara metro and funicular line design contract awarded
text:

TURKEY: Ankara municipality’s transport directorate EGO has awarded a contract for the preparation of final designs for the planned M5 Kızılay – Dikmen metro line and the Kuğulu Park – Ataküle – Turan Güneş funicular.

The TL31m contract with a consortium of Tümaş Türk Mühendislik and TPF Getinsa Euroestudios SL covers all technical and engineering studies and final designs for the integrated implementation of both rail projects. The work is to be completed within one year.

The project has already received presidential approval and a construction tender is expected to be held once the design process is completed.

Metro line M5 will be 13 km long with 10 stations, while the funicular line will run for 3 km with three stations. The two lines are to be designed to increase public transport availability and reduce traffic congestion along the Kızılay – Dikmen corridor.

M5 is one of four lines being developed by the municipality as priority projects to improve the public transport system in the Turkish capital.

Construction of the 7.5 km eight station Dikimevi – Natoyolu Line began in mid-2025 with completion scheduled for January 2029.

The planned 9.4 km five station M2 Koru – Yaşamkent – Bağlıca extension and the 12.5 km M6 Çayyolu – Sincan Connection Line have received presidential approval. The tender process for the M2 extension is ongoing, while tendering for construction of M6 is expected to begin by the end of 2026.
